title: Be My Vision
lyrics: Verse 1:
Be my vision when the waves are closing in
Keep my focus on the peace, You breathed within
And my heart will fear no more
As I turn to face You, Lord
Chorus 1:
Take this life let glory and majesty
Flood my eyes Lord, overwhelm me till
all that I want and all that I see is You
Till all that I see is You
Verse 2:
Be my vision when I've reached life's greatest day
Give me wisdom that I will humble myself and pray
Teach my heart to lean on You
Lord, in everything I do
Chorus 2:
Take this life let glory and majesty
Flood my eyes Lord, overwhelm me till
All that I want and all that I see is You
Step by step, Jesus, I'll follow You
Breath by breath, Lord, I will worship You
Burn in my heart till all that I see is You
Chorus 3:
PostTill all that I see is You, till all that I see is You
Till all that I see is You, Jesus
Till all that I see is You, till all that I see is You
Till all that I see is You, Jesus
Bridge 1:
I can see You now, I can see You now
Lord, You are here with me You're present in everything
So I'll lift my voice I have resolved to serve You, Lord
Jesus be all I see, Jesus in everything
Chorus 4:
Take this life let glory and majesty
Flood my eyes Lord, overwhelm me till
All that I want and all that I see is You
Step by step, Jesus, I'll follow You
Breath by breath, Lord, I will worship You
Burn in my heart till all that I see is You
Chorus 5:
PostTill all that I see is You, till all that I see is You
Till all that I see is You, Jesus
Till all that I see is You, till all that I see is You
Till all that I see is You, Jesus
